svg.title: paddock: live preview
svg.desc: Recorded from paddock 0.5.0 in a scratch tmux server; staged sessions. Shows the selected pane, live, beside the agents list. Steps: 1. The agents tab, with the selected pane beside it. 2. The pane keeps writing, and so does the preview. 3. Move to another agent: the preview follows. 4. Nothing was opened or switched.
